quotes.author: Chuck Shorten
quotes.text: Five Stars: We enjoyed our canal boat rental from Erie Canal Adventures - the boat was clean, comfortable, ready on time and it worked flawlessly. Classroom and on-the-water training met all our needs and then some (it lasted a little longer than expected) but we came with somewhat extensive boat experience already. We had a three-night rental and we enjoyed the whole experience. It was a bit of a step back in time to a slower pace. I would recommend this trip and this company to anyone interested in a laid-back look at this corner of New York.

quotes.author: PamJEtu
quotes.text: We did a 7 day adventure on the Lockmaster 34 boat named Canadice. The first day, arriving, training and sent off on our own was a lot! It was a busy day and we docked at Pittsford that night. We had a great meal, stopped at a local bar and it was so fun! Every night we were at a different canal side town and they were all different & interesting. We would do it again. The Erie Canal Adventures staff equipped us for fun! It was awesome! Just do it!

quotes.author: David Cronshaw
quotes.text: Great time and great people. Three life-long friends and I took a 3 night trip on the Cayuga canal boat heading west. The boat was great; equipped with everything we needed and the canal was awesome. Using the locks added another dimension to the experience. Thank you Erie Canal Adventures! I hope I can come back and do it again someday.

I would highly recommend this trip. We had very little boating experience and with the great orientation were able to navigate the locks and docking with relative ease. The company is very well run and organized. We had a very enjoyable and relaxing time touring and visiting various canal towns.
